text:
arjun: Quick idea : add an 'audit-lock' for accounts that are mid-merge or manual cleanup so automated playbooks temporarily suppress outbound actions but still record skipped events for follow-up.
megan: Love it. Avoids accidental double outreach while keeping traceability. How would it differ from existing mutes?
oliver: Mutes are template-scoped. Audit-lock is account-scoped + write-once audit record per lock. Think: lock(account_id, actor, reason, expires_at, snapshot).
ea: Snapshot should capture health_score, active_templates, last_owner_change_ts. Useful for post-mortem.
cs-tooling-bot: dry-run: scanning staging dataset : 4,912 accounts with recent CRM-change events. Potential locks: 582. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/cs/audit-lock/2890012345
arjun: Proposed API: POST /admin/locks {account_id, reason, ttl_hours} -> returns lock_id, expires_at. GET /admin/locks?account_id=... for UI.
megan: Runner changes: before enqueuing an action, check locks table. If locked -> emit metric playbook.skipped.lock_{reason} and write a skipped_audit row with run_id, lock_id, actor.
oliver: DB schema sketch: cs_locks(account_id text primary key, lock_id uuid, actor text, reason text, created_at timestamptz, expires_at timestamptz, snapshot jsonb, retention_days int). Default retention 14 days.
ea: Legal prefers 14 days for intermediate logs; ok to keep longer in special cases. Make retention configurable per-customer.
arjun: UI: show "Locked: reason" banner in account sidebar and a compact audit table of skipped events with timestamps. Also allow manual 'force send' with justification modal (stores override in audit).
megan: Race conditions: two systems might try to set a lock simultaneously. Use upsert that keeps earliest created_at but longest expires_at. Pseudocode: ```sql
INSERT INTO cs_locks (...) VALUES (...)
ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = GREATEST(cs_locks.expires_at, EXCLUDED.expires_at), snapshot = EXCLUDED.snapshot, actor = EXCLUDED.actor WHERE cs_locks.created_at > EXCLUDED.created_at;
```
(we'll adjust after review)
oliver: Also add a small backfill job that converts recent CRM-change events into suggested locks so CS can review and apply in bulk.
cs-tooling-bot: task-created: CS-8420 audit-lock API + runner guard (assignee: oliver). CS-8421 UI banner + override flow (assignee: megan).
ea: QA: tests for lock expiry, manual override logging, and metric emission. Also ensure alert if locks/day > 300 to catch bulk misapplication.
arjun: Rollout plan: feature flag `cs_audit_lock_v1` OFF. Enable 2% of accounts, monitor playbook.skipped.lock_* and manual_override counts.
megan: Nice. I'll draft an enablement note explaining how CS should use locks vs templates vs mutes. Short video + one-pager.
oliver: I'll open the PR for migration and runner changes today. ETA staged deploy tomorrow 11:00 PT.
arjun: Thanks team. Closing thread; will post PR links and backfill job results here.
